say:1:1721804001:1.text: Jacky, please give Cyclone a double ration and check its horseshoes. I need it in top condition, as I'll be heading out—
say:1:1721804001:1.source_cn: 约翰，帮我给风暴喂双份的草料，再检查一下马蹄铁。我需要...

say:2:1721804002:1.text: Good morning, my lady... I mean, Captain Gwyneth. No need to worry! Cyclone's already had his fill of the finest black beans and oats.
say:2:1721804002:1.source_cn: 早安，大小姐……哦不，格温妮丝队长。您不用急，风暴已经...

say:3:1721804003:1.text: I replaced its horseshoes last night, and I've fitted the saddle for you.
say:3:1721804003:1.source_cn: 马蹄铁昨晚刚换了新的，马鞍我也帮您装好了。

say:4:1721804004:2.text: All done? But I didn't tell anyone I'd be traveling far...
say:4:1721804004:2.source_cn: 喂好了？我没有提前通知我要……出远门。

say:5:1721804005:2.text: Gwyneth walks up to Cyclone and notices the saddlebags bulging on both sides, with even a spare quiver hung within easy reach.
say:5:1721804005:2.source_cn: 格温妮丝走到战马旁，发现马鞍两侧的行囊鼓鼓囊囊的，甚至...

say:6:1721804006:1.text: She checks one of the saddlebags and finds it stuffed with jerky, water, medicinal herbs, and a pouch of gold coins.
say:6:1721804006:1.source_cn: 她查看了一下行囊，里面是肉干、清水、急救草药，甚至还有...

say:7:1721804007:1.text: Jacky, what's with all this? Who asked you to prepare everything?
say:7:1721804007:1.source_cn: 约翰，这是怎么回事？谁让你准备这些的？

say:8:1721804008:2.text: It was the Commander. He came by earlier, before sunrise.
say:8:1721804008:2.source_cn: 是司令大人。天还没亮的时候，司令大人就一个人来了这里。

say:9:1721804009:1.text: He spent a long time with Cyclone, grooming him while telling me to get everything ready.
say:9:1721804009:1.source_cn: 他在风暴旁边站了很久，一边帮它梳毛，一边吩咐我把这些东...

say:10:1721804010:1.text: Father? I thought he was against me going to the front lines...
say:10:1721804010:1.source_cn: 父亲……？他不是……一直反对我去前线吗？

say:11:1721804011:1.text: I'm not sure about that, but I did hear the Commander say you're as stubborn as your bow...
say:11:1721804011:1.source_cn: 那我就不知道了，我只听到了司令大人说您的脾气和手里的弓...

say:12:1721804012:1.text: He knew he couldn't stop you from leaving, so he wanted you to be fully prepared for the journey.
say:12:1721804012:1.source_cn: 既然怎么拦都拦不住，与其让您赌气空着手跑出去受苦，不如...

say:13:1721804013:0.text: Oh, and the Commander said this, "Remind her to know her limits on the battlefield. Staying alive matters more than any glory."
say:13:1721804013:0.source_cn: 哦，他还让我转告您——“告诉她，到了灰影郡别逞强。活着...

say:14:1721804014:2.text: ... Father worries too much. It's not like I can't look after myself.
say:14:1721804014:2.source_cn: ……父亲也是，多此一举，我又不是不能照顾好自己。

say:15:1721804015:0.text: Yes, yes, the great Captain Gwyneth can handle everything on her own. Well... I guess I'll just wish you a safe journey.
say:15:1721804015:0.source_cn: 是是是，队长最独立了。那……祝您平平安安顺顺利利？

say:17:1721804017:1.text: One last look at my equipment... then I'll be on my way!
say:17:1721804017:1.source_cn: 我最后再确认一遍行装……就离开！
